note: [L] proves $Mf(1)=\int_0^\infty f$ for any `φ`, but $G_\delta(1)=\widehat\eta(-\delta)$ only for the two smoothings it uses ($t^2e^{-t^2/2}$ and $\eta_+$), not for general $\eta$; the main term of `explicit_formula_zeta` stays `mellin φ 1`.

snippet.text:
theorem mellin_one_eq {φ : ℝ → ℂ} : mellin φ 1 = ∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), φ t := by
  unfold mellin
  refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun t _ => ?_
  simp

proof_context.conclusion: For any `φ`, `mellin φ 1 = ∫_{(0,∞)} φ t`: $Mf(1)=\int_0^\infty f(t)\,dt$.

snippet.text:
/-- `M(1) = ∫₀^∞ t² e^{−t²/2} e(δt) dt = η̂(−δ)` (`η` cut off at `0`). -/
theorem mellin_fδ_one (δ : ℝ) :
    mellin (fδ δ) 1 = 𝓕 (fun u : ℝ => ((if 0 < u then u ^ 2 * Real.exp (-u ^ 2 / 2) else 0 : ℝ) : ℂ)) (-δ) := by
  rw [Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul, mellin]
  set g : ℝ → ℂ := fun v => Complex.exp (↑(-2 * π * v * -δ) * Complex.I) •
    (((if 0 < v then v ^ 2 * Real.exp (-v ^ 2 / 2) else 0 : ℝ) : ℂ)) with hg
  have hR : ∫ v : ℝ, g v = ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), g v :=
    (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero (fun u hu => by
      have : ¬ 0 < u := hu
      simp [hg, this])).symm
  rw [hR]
  refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun t (ht : 0 < t) => ?_
  simp only [hg, sub_self, Complex.cpow_zero, one_smul, if_pos ht, fδ, smul_eq_mul]
  push_cast; ring_nf

proof_context.conclusion: For $\eta(t)=t^2e^{-t^2/2}$ (cut off at 0), `mellin (fδ δ) 1 = 𝓕 η (−δ)`: $G_\delta(1)=\int_0^\infty\eta(t)e(\delta t)dt=\widehat\eta(-\delta)$.

snippet.text:
theorem mellin_fP_one (δ : ℝ) : mellin (fP δ) 1 = 𝓕 (fun u => (etaPlus u : ℂ)) (-δ) := by
  rw [Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul, mellin]
  set g : ℝ → ℂ := fun v => Complex.exp (↑(-2 * π * v * -δ) * Complex.I) • ((etaPlus v : ℝ) : ℂ) with hg
  have hR : ∫ v : ℝ, g v = ∫ v in Ioi (0:ℝ), g v :=
    (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero (fun u hu => by
      have : u ≤ 0 := not_lt.1 hu
      simp [hg, etaPlus_of_nonpos this])).symm
  rw [hR]
  refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun t (ht : 0 < t) => ?_
  simp only [hg, sub_self, Complex.cpow_zero, one_smul, fP, smul_eq_mul]
  push_cast; ring_nf

proof_context.conclusion: The same identity `mellin (fP δ) 1 = 𝓕 η₊ (−δ)` for $\eta_+$.

proof.summary: `mellin_one_eq` shows the Mellin transform at 1 is the plain integral, and `mellin_fδ_one` and `mellin_fP_one` identify it with the Fourier transform of eta at -delta.
